newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: German oil product sales dip in first five months.
newsitem.headline: German oil product sales dip in first five months.

text.p: Sales of oil products in Germany fell by 1.7 percent in the first five months of the year to 51.6 million tonnes, the German economics agency said on Friday.
Exports of oil products dipped by 0.4 percent to 5.6 million tonnes in the months January to May, while imports rose by 4.8 percent to 19.6 million tonnes.
Heating oil sales were 5.6 percent lower than in the same period of 1996, at 15.3 million tonnes.
Fuel oil sales fell by 14.7 percent to 2.5 million tonnes.
Diesel sales rose by 1.0 percent to 10.3 million tonnes.
Gasoline sales fell by 0.9 percent to 12.1 million tonnes. -- Amsterdam newsroom +31 20 504 5000, Fax +31 20 504 5040
